cases.title: Licensed user opens Travel Desk
cases.what: A user with thinkspace-travel license opens the Travel module and sees the hub layout.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in.
2. Navigate to /thinkspace/travel.
3. Confirm Travel Desk heading and New request button.
4. Confirm page is not redirected to /403.

cases.title: Back link navigates to Thinkspace hub
cases.what: User returns to the Thinkspace hub from Travel Desk.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/travel.
2. Click Back.
3. Verify URL is /thinkspace.

cases.title: Guest is redirected to login
cases.what: Unauthenticated user cannot access Travel Desk.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/travel without session.
2. Verify redirect to /login.

cases.workflowStep: New request → fill required fields → Save draft
cases.title: Save a new travel request as Draft
cases.what: User creates a travel request with required fields and saves as draft.
cases.steps:
1. Click New request.
2. Fill title, destination, start/end dates.
3. Click Save draft.
4. Verify row appears with Draft status.
cases.expected: Travel request is saved with Draft status.

cases.workflowStep: Create draft with From/To leg fields
cases.title: Create draft with trip leg shown in list
cases.what: Optional leg fields persist and display on the list row.
cases.steps:
1. Open create form.
2. Fill required fields plus From and To.
3. Save draft.
4. Verify leg text on row.
validationPoints: Leg from → to visible on row
cases.expected: Trip leg displays on the travel request row.

cases.title: Toggle create form open and closed
cases.what: New request button shows and hides the inline create form.
cases.steps:
1. Click New request — form visible.
2. Click Close — form hidden.

cases.workflowStep: Submit create form with missing required fields
cases.title: Missing required fields block save
cases.what: Empty title, destination, or dates prevent creating a draft.
cases.steps:
1. Open create form.
2. Leave required fields empty.
3. Click Save draft.
4. Form remains open.
validationPoints: No new row with empty title
cases.expected: Draft is not created without required fields.

cases.title: Close form without saving does not create a row
cases.what: Closing the create form abandons in-progress input.
cases.steps:
1. Open form and type a title.
2. Click Close.
3. Verify no row with that title.

cases.title: Submit draft changes status to Submitted
cases.what: Requester submits a draft travel request for approval.
cases.steps:
1. Create draft.
2. Click Submit on row.
3. Verify status Submitted.

cases.title: Submit button hidden after submission
cases.what: Submitted requests no longer show the Submit action.
cases.steps:
1. Submit a draft.
2. Confirm Submit button not visible on row.
cases.expected: Submit is not offered on Submitted requests.

cases.title: Staff approves submitted travel request
cases.what: Staff user approves a submitted request; status becomes Approved.
cases.steps:
1. Create and submit request.
2. Click Approve.
3. Verify status Approved.

cases.title: Staff rejects submitted travel request
cases.what: Staff user rejects a submitted request; status becomes Rejected.
cases.steps:
1. Create and submit request.
2. Click Reject.
3. Verify status Rejected.

cases.title: Non-staff user does not see Approve or Reject
cases.what: Only staff users see approval actions on submitted requests.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as non-staff user.
2. Open submitted request row.
3. Approve/Reject not visible.

cases.title: Cancel draft travel request
cases.what: Requester cancels a draft request.
cases.steps:
1. Create draft.
2. Click Cancel.
3. Verify status Cancelled.

cases.title: Cancel submitted travel request
cases.what: Requester cancels a submitted request before approval.
cases.steps:
1. Create and submit.
2. Click Cancel.
3. Verify status Cancelled.

cases.workflowStep: Cancelled row has no Cancel button
cases.title: Cancel button hidden on Cancelled requests
cases.what: Terminal Cancelled status removes the Cancel action.
cases.steps:
1. Cancel a draft.
2. Confirm Cancel button not on row.
cases.expected: Cancel is not offered on Cancelled requests.

cases.workflowStep: Cancel on Rejected request via API
cases.title: Cancel on Rejected request shows error
cases.what: Backend blocks invalid cancel transition from Rejected.
cases.steps:
1. Create, submit, reject via UI.
2. Click Cancel on rejected row.
3. Error alert shown; status stays Rejected.
cases.expected: Invalid cancel is rejected by the server.

cases.title: Empty state when no travel requests
cases.what: When the user has no requests, a placeholder message is shown.
cases.steps:
1. Open Travel Desk with empty list.
2. Verify 'No travel requests yet.' message.

cases.workflowStep: List row shows destination, dates, status
cases.title: List row displays trip metadata
cases.what: Each row shows destination, date range, and status.
cases.steps:
1. Create draft with known destination and dates.
2. Verify row subtitle contains destination, dates, Draft.

cases.workflowStep: Approve travel → verify expense claim via API
cases.title: Approval seeds linked expense claim
cases.what: Approving travel auto-creates a draft expense claim linked to the trip.
cases.steps:
1. Create and submit request.
2. Approve.
3. API lists expense claim with travel_request link.
cases.expected: Draft expense claim is seeded after approval.
